title: Gare du Nord
axis: Positive X heads north-northeast along the roof and departing tracks. The public façade and Rue de Dunkerque lie toward negative X.
visualScope: Gare du Nord with its limestone south front, five principal glazed arches, clock, city figures, stone wings, iron-and-glass train sheds, platform furniture and open northern train throat.
heightPolicy: The 61.50 m model datum uses standard viewer terrain. Entrance thresholds, foundations, iron columns and platform slabs follow sampled local grade. The historic rooflines and facade cornices use level architectural controls.
limitations: Roof slopes, masonry details, city figures and structural ironwork are visual reconstructions from ordinary photographs. The mapped footprint fixes the position and signed orientation.

Platform slabs and column feet adapt to the coarse viewer elevations. The model retains the native rail paths, approach roads and surrounding buildings. The small annex volume follows its mapped plan with an approximate roof height. Below-ground concourses, signage schedules and working trains are outside the exterior scope.
